name: Hornero Weather
description: Weather 2.0: dashboard card and contextual bar indicator complementing native Weather with configurable density, a local wind-threshold alert and forecast detail from the PluginKit Weather facade only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Weather & Astronomy 2.0: dashboard card plus contextual bar indicator, configurable density and forecast days, local high-wind threshold alert, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog. Only PluginKit Weather fields are shown; official alerts and multi-location are not exposed by the facade and are labelled unavailable.
Dashboard card for current weather and forecast from the PluginKit Weather service, with a not-configured state instead of fake data.

forecastDays.description: Forecast entries to show (the 1.x card showed the first 3).

showHumidity.description: Show relative humidity when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showWind.description: Show wind speed in km/h when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showSunTimes.description: Show sunrise and sunset times from the Weather facade (the 1.x behaviour).

dataDensity.description: compact shows only temperature and description; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the derived forecast range.

windAlertKmh.description: Local high-wind alert threshold in km/h. Not an official alert; 1.x had no threshold.
